courses.summary: 以迦納金礦為例，將季節水量、採礦來源與品質追溯建立成可檢核表。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A Ghanaian gold case organises seasonal water, mining sources and quality traceability into checkable records. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
